svg.title: Identification-free mass-error precision from repeated observations
svg.desc: Synthetic repeated precursor and fragment observations give pairwise ppm errors; a robust median/MAD estimate, divided by the square root of two, gives single-measurement sigma; six sigma is the supported tolerance suggestion.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif
Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Synthetic data. The same ion is observed repeatedly; spread between repeats measures precision, not the search settings once used.
